categoryDefinitions.disabled-workflow: Historical workflow is retained for reference and is excluded from active CI and runtime authority.
categoryDefinitions.historical-documentation: Historical design, evidence, or product material is retained for reference and does not govern DocSpec.
categoryDefinitions.legacy-dependency-lock: Dependency lock for the predecessor tree is retained as history and does not govern current builds.
categoryDefinitions.legacy-fixture: Fixture or sample supports archived behavior and is excluded from current conformance.
categoryDefinitions.legacy-integration: Integration material is retained as history and is excluded from standalone DocSpec runtime authority.
categoryDefinitions.legacy-policy-conformance: Cross-product policy or conformance material is retained as history and does not govern standalone DocSpec.
categoryDefinitions.legacy-production-code: Pre-standalone implementation is retained for reference and is excluded from the installed DocSpec package.
categoryDefinitions.legacy-test: Test supports archived behavior and is excluded from current test discovery and conformance.
categoryDefinitions.legacy-tool: Tool supports archived behavior and is excluded from current commands, builds, and conformance.
